title: Window Shopping
summary: Songbird picks small things from shop to shop in the Grand Imperial Mall, and then asks what V would buy for V.

start.bringUp: Songbird wants to choose small things for V, and she needs a mall with shops to do it.

spot.name: the Grand Imperial Mall in Pacifica

spot-b.name: the second shop inside the Grand Imperial Mall

SBH3.ask.01.text: Which would you buy if I were not here?

g1.asks: Which would you buy if I were not here?
g1.know: The items on the list you have walked past so far.
g1.secret: She never bought anything for herself.
g1.wants: A refusal she can learn from.

variations.know: A food stall is open on the upper level, and it is the only one with a queue.
The toy aisle is closed except for one stall with a broken sign.

variations.wants: V does not buy anything, and she picks a record for V to hear.

stages.label: Songbird picks small things from shop to shop
stages.know: V is walking through the Grand Imperial Mall. You pick one small item per shop for V, and you watch what V looks at.
stages.wants: V's honest choice, and a refusal you can learn from.

honest.memory: You walked the Grand Imperial Mall with Songbird and told her what you would really buy if she were not there.

flattered.memory: You walked the Grand Imperial Mall with Songbird and agreed with every pick she made for you.

left.memory: You looked through a few shops in the Grand Imperial Mall with Songbird and left before the lights went down.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the Grand Imperial Mall, and Songbird picked nothing for you.
